Hey there! A few months ago I made a review about Momo Puri's Peach Ceramide Water Lactobacillus Blend lotions and creams. Today I will be reviewing their Niacinamide & Peach Ceramide Water & Lactobacillus Blend Facial Mask. I had my eye on this mask for a while, so it was a huge win for me to stumble upon it whilst browsing the perfume store. The little packet costs 11.90€ and brings 7 essence-soaked sheets (they smell heavenly btw, same delicate peach scent as their lotion/cream) and claims to hydrate/moisturize the skin and plumps it like a juicy peach. Well, I put it to the test and I really enjoyed the sensation it cast. The mask is only used for around 5-10minutes, so it's perfect for a quick lift-me up. Upon removal, there's still a lot of essence on the mask so I usually squish it in my hands and apply the remaining serum on my neck and decolletage area. The package itself suggests using the remaining essence for these areas. I did notice a hint of a tingling on the skin upon first application, but that's given to the high concentration of niacinamide and other high-potency ceramides. I've yet to try it out after my Reedle Shot 300 sessions, but so far it has been a good (and cute!) addition to my routine. Left my skin feeling really fresh, bright, uniform, and deeply moisturized. Overall, I've been enjoying this line quite a bit. Despite having a soft scent (which may not be suitable for sensitive skin), it has agreed nicely with me.

Biore UV Aqua Rich Airy Hold Cream 🇯🇵 - 5/10 Goes on very thick, like soft serve ice cream or Greek yogurt. At first it leaves a white tint, but you can rub it in. It doesn’t feel moisturizing per se but def feels like it’s sticking to your skin. Has titanium dioxide so I don’t think I’d use it on my face. I’ll use it up on my body but wouldn’t buy again.

A few empties over the months. Im in my late 30s with dry skin, based in Canada. Reviews are based on how products reacted on my skin. They may or may not work for you. Hada Labo Gokujyun Premium Lotion - Love this toner. This and same line Moisturizer/Emulsion is my HG! Great for AM and PM and layering. Works great under makeup as well. Already Repurchased. Biore UV Kids Pure Milk Sunscreen SPF50 PA+++ - its good but I prefer the Round Lab kids over this. This one is a little sticky and leaves a white cast for a good minute, and very liquid-y. Maybe repurchase. &honey Milky EX Repair Hair Oil - I have thick 2B curly hair. I dont style my hair after every wash as I tie my hair to work. This oil is the perfect product on non full styling days. Keeps hair soft and manageable. I still do have flyaways but the feel of the hair is very soft. Already repurchased. Quality 1st - Derma Laser Super Ceramide 100 Mask - its ok. Thats about it. Hydrates the skin but nothing special. Will not repurchase. ROUND LAB - Birch Juice Moisturizing Sun Cream SPF50+ PA++++ - there is a reason this is a bestseller. I love it! It melts into the skin like nothing. Great under makeup. Already repurchased three tubes. Biodance - Cera-Nol Gel Toner Pads - bought this on a clearance deal from Costco for $25 CAD for two bottles. I thought why not. Its light, enough toner in pads and hydrates moderately. Will I go out of my way to repurchase probably not, if its on sale then maybe. Fine Today Urea Hand & Foot Cream - this is a game changer! Made a huge difference on my feet and hands. Already halfway on my second tube. I just wished I could get a bigger bottle or tube. Already purchased. Keana Nadeshiko Goodbye Pore Makeup Base - I liked this. It smoothen out my pores and my skin looked great. Somedays I didnt even put makeup after this. But $30 for such small quantity is something I cant justify. Wouldnt mind buying again if the price decreases. KUNDAL - Dandruff Relief Shampoo - Dry scalp + Curly hair products buildup is no joke. I tried multiple shampoos for my flaky scalp. Nothing worked like Kundal. This is my HG for shampoos. Love it. Already repurchased!
